name: list_boards
description: List all boards with their ids, names and habit counts, and which one is active. Habit tools only work on the active board.

name: list_habits
description: List every habit on the active board with id, title, tags, description, placement (period or hour), position inside that placement, and today's done state. Returns confirmed data only; staged changes are not included.

name: add_habit
description: Stage a new habit on the active board. Give exactly one of period or hour. Use period unless the user states an exact hour. The result returns the new habit id.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags, e.g. "运动, 每天".

position.description: 0-based slot inside the target placement; omit to put it first.

name: update_habit
description: Stage edits to a habit's title, description or tags. Only the given fields change. Use move_habit to change its time.

name: move_habit
description: Stage moving a habit to another period or hour, or to another position in the same one. Give exactly one of period or hour.

position.description: 0-based slot inside the target placement; omit to put it last.

name: delete_habit
description: Stage deleting a habit. Only use when the user clearly asks to remove it.

name: set_habit_done
description: Stage checking or unchecking a habit as done today.
